summary.text: Roger Maki is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 26 (Watford City), serving since 2025. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Education and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Maki is retired and serves on the board of Cross Point Church.
In the interim he serves on the Legislative Audit and Fiscal Review Committee.
His biography lists him as married to MaryLynn, with two children and four grandchildren.
